question:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the incorrectly spelt word in the following sentence.

In our quest for power, we often fail to acknowlege the existence of other people.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"acknowlege"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be "acknowledge". (स्वीकार करना) • **Example: **He refused to acknowledge the fact that he had made a mistake. • **"Acknowledge" **means to accept or admit the existence or truth of something. (स्वीकार करना) • **Example: **She acknowledged receiving assistance from her colleagues. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **acknowledje** (अज्ञात): Incorrect spelling of acknowledge. • **Example:** This is an incorrect spelling and thus has no proper example. • **accknowledge** (अज्ञात): Incorrect spelling of acknowledge. • **Example:** This is an incorrect spelling and thus has no proper example. • **acknowlede** (अज्ञात): Incorrect spelling of acknowledge. • **Example:** This is an incorrect spelling and thus has no proper example. 121:Tb5e,
